title: Your first report
intro: Your very first set of leads: marketing, brand and partnerships roles in the LA area at French or France-tied companies. Every posting was open when I checked it on Oct 9.
notes: SMCP Group (Sandro, Maje, Claudie Pierlot, Fursac): nothing fits right now. Its LA openings are boutique retail roles and its corporate marketing jobs are in New York. It stays at the top of the daily watch list.

jobs.title: Manager, Global Brand Marketing (NYX Professional Makeup)
jobs.why: It's built around community strategy, partnerships, and activations (asks for 2-5 years), so your work building relationships and running events with Sensations lines up well with your marketing degree.

jobs.title: Manager, US Consumer Engagement (Youth To The People)
jobs.why: The job is about building relationships with creators, press, and agency partners, and that's what you already do with executives at Gartner.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager, Global Marketing (Youth To The People)
jobs.why: It asks for only 2+ years of marketing experience, so it's a realistic first step into brand management, and you'd be coordinating across teams like you do now.

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive, Talent & Partnerships
jobs.french_tie: Publicis Groupe is headquartered in Paris.
jobs.why: It wants 3-5 years in account management or sponsorship, and it covers contracts, negotiations, and client presentations, which is your Gartner work applied to brand partnerships.
jobs.status: Closed when I rechecked it later on Oct 9

jobs.title: Account Supervisor
jobs.why: It asks for 4 years of client service and a "relationship builder" who drives clients' marketing goals, which matches your time owning Fortune 500 relationships.

jobs.title: Fragrance & Beauty Account Executive, Los Angeles
jobs.why: It's a bridge role that leans more toward sales, but it's on the brand side of a French luxury house, running promotional programs with retail partners where your AE skills carry straight over. It asks for 5+ years.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.why: It's agency account management on creative brand work (1-3 years), an easy way in, though the pay is likely below what you make now.

jobs.title: Manager, TikTok Shop VIP Affiliate (Urban Decay)
jobs.work_arrangement: Hybrid: 3 days in office, 2 from home
jobs.why: It's a creator-partnerships job where recruiting and negotiating play to your strengths.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Creator Management
jobs.french_tie: Influential is part of Publicis Groupe (Paris HQ).
jobs.why: Casting, negotiating, and managing creator partnerships for Fortune 500 brands builds on your enterprise work.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 5-7 years in digital or creator marketing.
